entries.rule: retrodiction by post-dating (engagement is a target claim)
entries.note: Hope 2009 abstract quote verbatim (epub 2009-08-31). Fijen 2001 (oral RWJ-67657) and Branger 2002 (oral BIRB 796) cut human endotoxin TNF/IL-6 first, so retro is right. pha-797804, oral, healthy volunteers coded unselected fit.

entries.rule: dose table: model stated no exposure target or margin -> untested; rule 5
entries.note: Hope 2009 dose-projection sentence verbatim; abstract states no human exposure target or margin. Untested holds for pha-797804 oral (healthy volunteers). untested_reason should be no_prediction, not unsettled: the OA efficacy result never decides dose.
Brown 2008 conclusion verbatim (abstract, 2008-12-04). Opener untested 2008 for emprumapimod oral on the sibling-drug track; no member OA result yet.

entries.rule: efficacy primary endpoint; same in direction
entries.note: ACR 2012 primary WOMAC pain quote verbatim; emprumapimod oral, unselected knee OA, 2012. S-1 confirms FX005 primary (4-week WOMAC pain) showed relief, same direction; as an IA route it is strictly its own track, but changes no status here.

entries.rule: safety: predicted harm not measured in patients (untested, not_measured)
entries.note: S-1 (SEC, January 2014) quote verbatim, re-read. FX005 given as one 45 mg intra-articular injection to unselected knee-OA patients; drug, route, population fit. Untested holds.
Koch 2007 title and body re-read (PMC7095932, S376-S377, 2007). ARRY-797 is emprumapimod, dosed orally (25-400 mg). Opener untested 2007, drug and route correct.

entries.rule: engagement: did the PD readout the model used move in dosed humans; one system per model_id
entries.note: Body re-read: rodent CIA/AIA readout was joint histology (ED50~3 mg/kg); human ex-vivo LPS cytokine blockade (80% at 50 mg) matches only the in-vitro human whole-blood IC50, a separate system. Rodent readout never compared: untested, not retro. Drug/route fine.
entries.adjudication_note: Engagement rule: the rodent CIA/AIA readout (joint histology) was never measured in dosed humans; the ex-vivo LPS whole-blood blockade belongs to a separate human whole-blood system (one system per model_id). Untested; untested_reason no_prediction (rule 5) already set.

entries.rule: rule 6 opener; sibling drugs allowed (product_in_model false)
entries.note: Brown 2008 conclusion verbatim (Europe PMC abstract, epub 2008-12-04); SB-203580/VX-745 siblings. Opener for emprumapimod oral, the track's only scored member. Year, drug, route, population fine.

entries.rule: engagement downstream readout; rule 1 paired comparison
entries.note: ACR 2012 COMP/CTX-I sentence verbatim (re-read). Oral emprumapimod 400 mg q12h, unselected NSAID-refractory knee OA. 2008 model precedes the 2012 result; no earlier p38 patient cartilage-marker result found, so not retro.
Koch 2007 body confirms ARRY-797 normalised CIA/AIA inflammation, bone resorption and cartilage damage. Opener untested 2007, emprumapimod oral, correct.

entries.rule: efficacy primary endpoint; rule 1 paired comparison
entries.note: Kivitz 2012 primary-endpoint quote verbatim; model side Koch 2007 (ARRY-797 itself). Prospective 2007 to 2012, no earlier p38 OA patient result. Emprumapimod oral, unselected knee OA; direction-only same holds.

missing: ARRY-797's own model, no track: Koch et al. 2007, 'ARRY-797, a selective, potent inhibitor of p38 active in animal models of rheumatoid arthritis, inhibits ex vivo IL-1, PGE2 and TNF production in normal human subjects', Inflamm Res 2007;56(Suppl 3):S376-S377 (abstract book doi 10.1007/BF03353884; relayed by Mavers 2009 Curr Rheumatol Rep doi 10.1007/s11926-009-0054-9: rodent CIA/adjuvant arthritis plus ex-vivo LPS whole-blood PGE2/IL-1/TNF inhibition up to 100% in dosed healthy subjects). A member-drug engagement comparison (readout_tier direct) dated 2007, two years before Hope 2009; abstract body not retrieved (ResearchGate metadata and citing text only).

Patient-side engagement on the rat-iodoacetate track, no entry: Kivitz 2012 ACR abstract L1 reports ARRY-797 cut serum COMP 10% and CTX-I 38% vs placebo at week 4 in knee-OA patients (same URL as efficacy entry 2). Brown 2008 predicted joint-degeneration inhibition; the cartilage/bone degradation biomarkers moving in patients is a downstream engagement comparison the engagement cell (currently healthy-volunteer endotoxin only) should carry as a 2012 entry.

Not a model, a sponsor record the dose/efficacy notes could cite: Pfizer pipeline PDF dated 2011-11-10 (https://cdn.pfizer.com/pfizercom/research/pipeline/2011_1110/pipeline_2011_1110.pdf) lists PH-797804 for COPD Phase 2 only, nine months after NCT01102660 completed (2011-02), so the OA indication was dropped without a stated result. It does not report the outcome, so no status changes.

No further model system for this class found (checked_by CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models). The only other Array ARRY-797 model abstracts are oncology: Wright/Winski et al., Blood 2006;108(11):3478 'ARRY-797 ... Inhibits LPS-Induced IL-6 and In Vivo Growth of RPMI-8226 Human Multiple Myeloma Cells' (https://ashpublications.org/blood/article/108/11/3478/128129) and Ann Oncol 2007;18 Suppl 4 xenograft abstract. The Blood LPS-IL-6 result (in vitro or in vivo not known from the title) would be ARRY-797's own model_src for the existing rat-endotoxin-tnf-pd track, paired with the Koch 2007 human ex-vivo PD; not a new system.
rule_questions: Conference abstracts have no tier: the ACR 2012 late-breaking abstract (Arthritis Rheum 64 Suppl 10, sponsor-authored, unreviewed, no DOI) and the EFIC 2011 abstract (Eur J Pain Suppl, has a DOI) are neither tier 1 papers nor tier 5 press releases. The draft scored the ACR abstract as tier 5 with trial_unreported true; is that the rule?

Safety: a tox-predicted harm (FX005 cartilage damage at HED >=10 mg) where the only trial (45 mg, 12 weeks, no imaging) could not detect the cartilage endpoint but could and did assess the synovitis component clinically (local tolerability HA-like). Untested as drafted, or contra/opposite for the assessable component? And if the repeat-dose tox post-dated the trial while the clinic never measured the endpoint, is it a prospective prediction, a retrodiction, or neither?

Evidence rule 2 requires a tier 1-3 model_src on a tier 4-5 entry, but the only source for FX005's rat toxicology is the SEC S-1 itself (model_src_tier null). Lint accepts it; may an untested safety entry stand on a tier-5 model side when no higher-tier model source exists?

A sponsor pipeline document silently dropping an indication after a completed, unreported trial (PH-797804 OA): is that an admissible tier-5 failure signal, or nothing until a result is stated? The dose cell's untested depends on the answer.

Dose entry 1 carries trial_unreported true on a source_tier 1 entry; the brief ties trial_unreported to tier 5. Should trial_unreported be allowed on any tier when the relevant patient trial itself is unreported?

Engagement on a cross-indication track where the human PD readout (ex-vivo LPS whole-blood cytokines in dosed volunteers, Koch 2007) was never a readout of the rodent model (CIA/adjuvant arthritis scores): is a title that lists both findings enough for comparison_stated true and same, or does decision 4 require the model itself to have used the readout (untested, with the human PD re-homed on the rat-endotoxin-tnf-pd track)? (CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models, engagement 3)
